cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Dural venous sinuses, meninges and cranial markings

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Runs in attached superior border of falx cerebri.
cards.section: Dural venous sinuses, meninges and cranial markings

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Receives cerebral veins and CSF via arachnoid granulations; drains toward confluence of sinuses.
cards.section: Dural venous sinuses, meninges and cranial markings

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Dural venous sinuses, meninges and cranial markings

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Runs laterally from confluence of sinuses along tentorial attachment.
cards.section: Dural venous sinuses, meninges and cranial markings

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Continues as sigmoid sinus and ultimately internal jugular vein.
cards.section: Dural venous sinuses, meninges and cranial markings

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Dural venous sinuses, meninges and cranial markings

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Tough outer meningeal layer; cranial dura has periosteal and meningeal layers.
cards.section: Dural venous sinuses, meninges and cranial markings

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Protects CNS and forms dural folds and venous sinuses.
cards.section: Dural venous sinuses, meninges and cranial markings

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Dural venous sinuses, meninges and cranial markings

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Small depressions on inner calvaria produced by arachnoid granulations.
cards.section: Dural venous sinuses, meninges and cranial markings

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Commonly adjacent to superior sagittal sinus.
cards.section: Dural venous sinuses, meninges and cranial markings

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Reflect sites where arachnoid granulations project for CSF absorption.
cards.section: Dural venous sinuses, meninges and cranial markings

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Impression left by branch of middle meningeal artery
cards.section: Dural venous sinuses, meninges and cranial markings

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Grooves on internal surface of skull, especially parietal/temporal regions.
cards.section: Dural venous sinuses, meninges and cranial markings

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Produced by middle meningeal artery and branches.
cards.section: Dural venous sinuses, meninges and cranial markings

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Temporal bone fracture may lacerate the middle meningeal artery and cause an epidural haematoma.
cards.section: Dural venous sinuses, meninges and cranial markings

cards.section: Glands

cards.section: Glands

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Glands

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Between mandibular ramus and mastoid/SCM region.
cards.section: Glands

cards.question: Function
cards.section: Glands

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Parotid duct opens opposite upper second molar.
cards.section: Glands

cards.answer: Parasympathetic secretomotor pathway from CN IX via otic ganglion and auriculotemporal nerve.
cards.section: Glands

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Glands

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Submandibular triangle, wrapping around posterior mylohyoid border.

cards.question: Function
cards.section: Glands

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Submandibular duct opens beside lingual frenulum at sublingual papilla.
cards.section: Glands

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Parasympathetic fibres from CN VII via chorda tympani, lingual nerve and submandibular ganglion.
cards.section: Glands

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Glands

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Anterior neck, with lobes alongside upper trachea joined by an isthmus.
cards.section: Glands

cards.question: Function
cards.section: Glands

cards.question: Blood supply
cards.answer: Superior and inferior thyroid arteries, with a variable thyroid ima artery.

cards.answer: Recurrent laryngeal nerves lie close to the posteromedial gland; external laryngeal nerve relates to superior thyroid vessels.

cards.question: Identification

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Higher cognition, conscious sensation, voluntary movement, language and behaviour.

cards.question: Identification

cards.label: B

cards.question: Location

cards.label: B

cards.question: Function

cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: B

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: C

cards.question: Function

cards.question: Identification

cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contains vital autonomic centres and ascending/descending pathways.
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: D

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: E

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Executive function, behaviour, motor planning and primary motor cortex.
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: E

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: F

cards.question: Function

cards.label: G

cards.question: Function
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: G

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: H

cards.question: Function

cards.label: H

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: J

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Thin vascular meningeal layer closely adherent to brain surface.
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: J

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Covers CNS surface and follows sulci.
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: J

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: K

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Projections of arachnoid mater into dural venous sinuses.
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: K

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Permit CSF absorption into venous circulation.
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: K

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: L

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Tough outer cranial meninx with periosteal and meningeal layers.
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: L

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Forms dural folds and venous sinuses.
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: L

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: M

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Vertical dural fold between cerebral hemispheres.
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: M

cards.question: Attachments
cards.answer: Attaches anteriorly to crista galli and posteriorly blends with tentorium cerebelli.
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: M

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: N

cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: N

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Receives cerebral veins and CSF via arachnoid granulations.
cards.section: Gross brain, meninges and venous structures (A–N)
cards.label: N

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Separates temporal lobe from frontal/parietal lobes.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Relations
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Medial temporal lobe, forming floor of inferior horn of lateral ventricle.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Critical for formation and consolidation of declarative memory.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: C-shaped basal ganglia nucleus with head, body and tail.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Participates in motor, cognitive and behavioural circuits.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Paired diencephalic structure bordering third ventricle.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Major sensory and motor relay to cerebral cortex.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Largest commissural fibre bundle connecting cerebral hemispheres.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Parts
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Structure
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Major hippocampal output pathway toward mammillary bodies and septal regions.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Connects temporal and olfactory-related regions across hemispheres.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Important in bilateral pupillary light-reflex pathways.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Variable midline connection between medial surfaces of the thalami.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Inferior to thalamus, forming floor and lower walls of third ventricle.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Regulates autonomic, endocrine, thermoregulatory and homeostatic functions.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Location
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Connections
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Dorsal midbrain; inferior colliculus is part of the tectum.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Inferior colliculus participates in auditory pathways and reflexes.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Location
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Function
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Branching cerebellar white matter visible in sagittal section.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Carries fibres to and from cerebellar cortex.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Receives axons from olfactory receptor neurons through the cribriform plate.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Continues posteriorly as the olfactory tract.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Causes anosmia; cribriform plate injury may also produce CSF rhinorrhoea.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Roots
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Passes through optic canal to optic chiasm.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Vision and afferent limb of pupillary light reflex.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Causes ipsilateral monocular blindness and a relative afferent pupillary defect.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Arises from oculomotor nuclear complex in the midbrain at the level of the superior colliculus.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Emerges from ventral midbrain, passes through cavernous sinus and superior orbital fissure.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: Supplies superior, inferior and medial recti, inferior oblique and levator palpebrae; carries parasympathetic fibres to sphincter pupillae and ciliary muscle.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Causes ptosis, a 'down and out' eye, diplopia and often a dilated pupil with loss of accommodation.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Arises from trochlear nucleus in midbrain at level of inferior colliculus.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Only cranial nerve to exit dorsally; traverses cavernous sinus and superior orbital fissure.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Causes vertical diplopia worse looking down and in; patient may tilt head away from affected side.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Large sensory and small motor roots emerge from lateral pons.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Sensory root reaches trigeminal ganglion; divisions V1, V2 and V3 leave through superior orbital fissure, foramen rotundum and foramen ovale respectively.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: Motor root travels with V3 to muscles of mastication and selected other muscles.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Principal sensory nerve of face; also cornea, oral/nasal cavities and general sensation from anterior two-thirds of tongue via V3.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: May cause ipsilateral facial sensory loss; motor root involvement weakens mastication and jaw deviates toward the lesion.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Arises from abducens nucleus in pons.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Emerges at pontomedullary junction, passes through cavernous sinus and superior orbital fissure.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Causes inability to abduct the affected eye, horizontal diplopia and medial deviation.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Motor root and nervus intermedius emerge at pontomedullary junction.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Enters internal acoustic meatus, traverses facial canal, exits stylomastoid foramen and branches within parotid gland.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: Supplies muscles of facial expression, stapedius, stylohyoid and posterior belly of digastric.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Taste from anterior two-thirds of tongue and small somatic sensory component; also carries parasympathetic fibres.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: A lower motor neuron lesion causes ipsilateral weakness of upper and lower facial muscles; taste, lacrimal or salivary deficits depend on lesion level.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Peripheral processes arise from vestibular and cochlear sensory receptors; central processes enter at pontomedullary junction.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Travels through internal acoustic meatus with CN VII.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: May cause sensorineural hearing loss, tinnitus, vertigo and imbalance depending on the division affected.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Roots
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Exits skull via jugular foramen and descends between internal carotid artery and internal jugular vein toward pharynx/tongue.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: Supplies stylopharyngeus; parasympathetic secretomotor pathway supplies parotid gland.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Taste and general sensation from posterior third of tongue; carotid body/sinus afferents; afferent limb of gag reflex.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: May cause loss of posterior tongue taste/sensation, impaired afferent gag reflex, dysphagia and reduced parotid secretion.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Spinal rootlets arise from upper cervical spinal cord, classically C1–C5/6.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Ascends through foramen magnum, exits jugular foramen and crosses posterior triangle.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Causes weak head turning away from the affected side and ipsilateral shoulder droop with weak shrug.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Roots
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Exits jugular foramen and descends within carotid sheath into thorax.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: Supplies palate, pharynx and larynx and carries parasympathetic fibres to thoracoabdominal viscera.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Visceral sensation, laryngeal/pharyngeal sensation and taste from epiglottic region.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: May cause dysphagia and hoarseness, ipsilateral palatal weakness with uvula deviating away from the lesion, and loss of the efferent gag reflex.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Identification
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Arises from hypoglossal nucleus in medulla.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Exits via hypoglossal canal and courses anteriorly to tongue.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: Supplies intrinsic and extrinsic tongue muscles except palatoglossus.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Lower motor neuron lesion causes ipsilateral tongue weakness, atrophy/fasciculations and deviation toward the lesion on protrusion.
cards.section: Internal brain structures and cranial nerves (1–26)
